newsitem.title: UNITED ARAB EMIRATES: SOCCER-CHINA, SOUTH KOREA REACH LAST EIGHT OF ASIA CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CHINA, SOUTH KOREA REACH LAST EIGHT OF ASIA CUP.

text.p: On a day when China lost and South Korea did not play, both countries still managed to take the last two berths in the Asian Cup quarter-finals on Thursday.

The Chinese, who went down 1-0 to an injury time winner by Japanese defender Naoki Soma, owed their place to Syria's surprise 2-1 victory over newcomers Uzbekistan who won the Asian Games tournament two years ago.
China's goal difference was better than both Syria and Uzbekistan and they qualified in second place in group C behind Japan.

That result also ensured that South Korea, one of the favourites before the 12-nation tournament began, would qualify for the last eight from group A as one of the two best teams in third position in the three groups.
Syria took the lead after just three minutes through Nader Jokhadar but Sergey levelled after 53 minutes from the penalty spot.
Dib restored Syria's lead in the 72nd minute and Uzbekistan's disappointment was completed two minutes later when Sergey was sent off .
The quarter-final stage kicks off on Sunday when the United Arab Emirates play Iraq in Abu Dhabi and Kuwait face Japan in Al-Ain.
On Monday Iran play South Korea in Dubai and Saudi Arabia take on China in Abu Dhabi.
